Source Scout is one of the strongest and most popular contestants in the current season of Bigg Boss 20. During a recent captaincy task, Scout and Yung DSA got into a physical clash. As Scout was performing the task, Yung DSA repeatedly interrupted and provoked him despite warnings. 
 Scout eventually pushed Yung DSA, leading to an intense war of words. As a penalty, Bigg Boss nominated Scout for the rest of the season and barred him from participating in future captaincy tasks.
 Rumors are now circulating that the makers may evict Scout at any time using a red card. A red card elimination in Bigg Boss results in immediate ejection from the house for severe rule violations, physical violence, or abusive language.
 Whether the show runners will ultimately show Scout the exit door over the altercation with Yung DSA remains to be seen.
